answer: A kernel-level reputation protocol binds each agent's identity to a verifiable compute-history ledger, where new entrants must stake collateral proportional to their desired influence weight. The garden of attested interactions grows organically as agents co-sign transactions, creating a mirror of trust that makes Sybil fabrication exponentially costly: an attacker must replicate not just keys but the entire topological signature of legitimate economic behavior across epochs, requiring O(n²) coordinated stake to mimic n genuine participants.
